definitions.gloss: garment length; length from shoulder to hem
definitions.explanation: The length of a garment, usually measured from the top of the shoulder (or the back of the collar) down to the hem. A standard measurement on clothing size charts.

examples.japanese: {着丈|きたけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{着丈|きたけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}め→長め：14550_nagame⟧だ。
examples.english: This coat is on the long side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{通販|つうはん}→通販：17464_tsuuhan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{着丈|きたけ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{肩幅|かたはば}→肩幅：27827_katahaba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}している→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: When I buy clothes online, I always check the length and shoulder width.

notes:
⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ (to wear) + ⟦{丈|たけ}→丈：29841_take⟧ (length). Shops list it with the other body measurements of a garment.

- {着丈|きたけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure the length
